hooks.text: This is the one drawing that kills most planning applications before they're even read.
67% of UK home extensions run over budget. Same reason every time.
My client came to me with full planning approval. I told them to pause.
This kitchen extension looks perfect. It cost £18,000 more than it should have.
Stop trying to add value to your house. It's the wrong goal.
Extend vs move. I ran the real numbers for a 3-bed in Birmingham.
What your architect checks before drawing a single line.
Most loft conversions don't need planning permission. Here's when yours does.

ctas.phrase: Save this for when you start planning.

ctas.phrase: Book a Build, Wait or Move Call via the link in bio.

ctas.phrase: Comment 'PLANS' and I'll tell you exactly what yours needs.
Drop your postcode below — I'll tell you what's allowed.

ctas.phrase: Follow for the part 2 — the numbers get worse.
ctas.signal: High follow rate on multi-part content

formats.description: Inverse hook opening — show the wrong thing first, then correct it
formats.structure: Wrong thing → hard truth → correct approach → CTA

formats.description: Stat-led — cold number drop with no context, then the explanation
formats.structure: Stat → why it matters → what to do → CTA

formats.description: Cost breakdown — line by line with the total saved for the final shot
formats.structure: Promise breakdown → each line → total reveal → CTA

formats.description: Myth bust — state the myth as fact, then dismantle with evidence
formats.structure: State myth → evidence → correct framework → CTA

formats.description: Decision framework — give viewers a clear yes/no decision tool
formats.structure: Decision question → criteria → verdict logic → CTA
